Troubleshooting · 05/50 · rights

Location permit gap

Failure signal

A location permit gap condition is reported or detected during rights.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for rights does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Match each scheduled location and activity to a valid permit and property release.

Corrective action

Move the scene, narrow the activity or secure written permission before call time.

Prevention

Add this verification to the rights gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
